ios.desc:
Ever wished you could remember exactly where you went last Tuesday?
Or retrace that perfect walk you took months ago?
Or finally answer "wait, have I been here before?"

Breadcrumbs quietly records your location as you move through your day - no check-ins, no buttons to press, no effort. Just open the app and your journey is already there, waiting for you on the map.

YOUR LIFE, MAPPED AUTOMATICALLY
Breadcrumbs runs silently in the background, building a personal map of everywhere you've ever been. See today, last week, or years ago. Your history is always there, always private, always yours.

BUILT FOR REAL LIFE
• Travelers who want to remember every place they visited
• Drivers and delivery workers who need a record of their routes
• Anyone who's ever said "where did I park?" or "what was that street called?"
• Parents who want to know where their kids have been
• People who just love knowing their own story

BATTERY-FRIENDLY BY DESIGN
Unlike other trackers that drain your phone, Breadcrumbs is built to run all day without you noticing. Your location is recorded intelligently in the background - efficient by default, more precise when you need it.

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
Breadcrumbs stores everything on your device. No cloud. No selling your data. No one watching. If you use the location sharing feature, your data is end-to-end encrypted - not even we can read it.

PREMIUM FEATURES (just $9.99/year)
Unlock higher location precision, share your location with other devices, filter by date and time ranges, and import/export your data as GPX files. One subscription covers your iPhone and iPad under the same Apple ID or Family Sharing.

Retrace your steps. Rediscover your places. Remember your journey.

Terms Of Use / License agreement: http://www.devsincloud.com/breadcrumbs/terms-of-use.htm
Privacy Policy: http://www.devsincloud.com/breadcrumbs/privacy-policy.htm

quotes.text:
A simple iOS application to see where you have been with your phone and how far you have traveled each day.
The location information is collected in the background without draining the battery.

It is a free app! With the optional subscription to access more advanced features such as location sharing.

Based on feedback, the app was recently updated with improved filtering (date, time, ranges); new satellite map view; new import/export capability!

If you like the app, I will very much appreciate your support in a form of rating and/or review.

Thank you!
